description: This source file defines an enum LaunchdManager with static methods for managing launchctl tasks related to OpenClaw, including starting and stopping processes using launchctl commands.

classes.name: LaunchdManager
classes.description: An enum providing static methods to control launchctl processes for OpenClaw deployment.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: Private static method that executes the launchctl command with specified arguments.

methods.name: startOpenClaw
methods.description: Starts the OpenClaw process using launchctl kickstart.

methods.name: stopOpenClaw
methods.description: Stops the OpenClaw process using launchctl stop.
